author: NCramer
body:
Today I was bored and searching through my list of Minecraft servers and I saw: Avicus! i remember that server when I last played it (which was like last year or something) i tried to connect to it, then remembered that i had been banned. I had tried to appeal a long time ago, but realized that there was nowhere on your old website to appeal. Now on your new website, there is a place to appeal, so I am making an appeal. I was banned for fastbreak and speedhacking, although I have never, and do not hack, I do not even know how to hack! this is the only server that i have ever been banned on! Could I please be unbanned because all of my friends can play on avicus, but i can't. Thanks,

NCramer
